activation: on-demand after an approved defect requires Creation Kit evidence; not a prerequisite to multiplayer work or the v1 release
requiredBindings: structured evidence to raw xDump hash
pathBoundary: RunRoot and CaptureOutput must be canonical fully qualified fresh descendants of non-reparse C:\tmp; existing targets and any reparse ancestor are rejected.
publicOutputBoundary: Capture output accepts only strict public-safe identifiers, anonymous reviewer IDs and enumerated finding codes; private paths, account IDs, addresses, tokens and arbitrary review text are rejected rather than copied.
cleanupBoundary: Failure cleanup may delete only an output file demonstrably created by that invocation. Delete only the named disposable run root after retaining sanitized metadata; never commit plugins, masters, INIs, executables, PEX, raw dumps, or private submission JSON.
provenance: The historical Bethesda-derived replacement plugin is explicitly inadmissible. Only a fresh original-only human-operated CK round trip with named review may be submitted, and automated validation never marks it verified.
